<div class="card-body">
'''Garindan''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ガリンダン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">同じ位置に、能力値＞２の反乱軍キャラクターがいれば、その場の帝国軍キャラクターの配備コストが－１になる。また、隣接した位置からその場へ帝国軍キャラクターが移動する場合の移動コストが０になる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-177o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">クビンディ出身の鼻の長いクバーズ人男性。スパイ。ドッキング・ベイ９４の外でオビ＝ワンとルークの行方を密告した。金次第でジャバ・ザ・ハットなどにつく。意外と臆病。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Garindan.

'''Card text:''' If a Rebel of ability > 2 is at the same site, Imperial characters here deploy -1. Imperial characters moving here from an adjacent site move for 0.

'''Lore:''' A long-nosed Kubaz male from Kubindi. Spy. Informed on Obi-Wan and Luke outside Docking Bay 94. Works for Jabba the Hutt or whoever pays. Unexpectedly timid.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Garindan]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
